[OK] ContextBrake init (applied)

┌─ Harnesses
│  antigravity-cli     partial support (planned)
│                      post_tool_telemetry: Antigravity CLI PostToolUse accepts only empty output;
│                      telemetry is indirect via PreInvocation.
│                      session_boot: Session boot is indirect via PreInvocation.
│                      context_usage: Context usage is not exposed to Antigravity CLI hooks.
│                      auto_restart: No restart: this harness cannot inject the resume instruction.
│  claude-code         full support (planned)
│                      context_usage: Read from the session transcript, whose format is
│                      undocumented; falls back to an estimate. The context window comes from the
│                      mod that init installs on Claude Code 2.1.287 or later, or from the status
│                      line bridge on older versions; without either, it falls back to
│                      contextWindowCeiling.
│                      auto_restart: Opt-in through init --auto-restart; needs Claude Code 2.1.287
│                      or later with mods enabled. Run doctor to check that the mod loads.
│  codex-cli           full support (planned)
│                      context_usage: Read from the token_count events of the session rollout file,
│                      whose format is undocumented; falls back to an estimate. The context window
│                      comes from the same event; without it, the window falls back to
│                      contextWindowCeiling.
│                      auto_restart: Semi-automatic restart: run /new; the new session resumes by
│                      itself.
│  cursor              full support (planned)
│                      context_usage: Context usage reaches Cursor hooks only before compaction, so
│                      ContextBrake estimates it.
│                      auto_restart: Semi-automatic restart: start a new session; it resumes by
│                      itself.
│  github-copilot-cli  full support (planned)
│                      context_usage: Context usage is not exposed to GitHub Copilot CLI hooks.
│                      auto_restart: Semi-automatic restart: start a new session; it resumes by
│                      itself.
│  oh-my-pi            full support (planned)
│                      auto_restart: Semi-automatic restart: press Enter on the prefilled
│                      /context-brake-restart; the new session resumes by itself.
│  opencode            partial support (planned)
│                      post_tool_telemetry: Model visibility of post-tool output modification is
│                      unconfirmed in OpenCode.
│                      session_boot: Stable boot injection is experimental in OpenCode.
│                      context_usage: No documented API exposes context usage to OpenCode plugins.
│                      auto_restart: No restart: this harness cannot inject the resume instruction.
│  pi                  full support (planned)
└─
